prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your New Desktop Companion", "Sign in to sync your adopted pet across desktop devices and keep your pet data safe in the cloud.", "Signing in links your pet adoption certificate directly to your account."]
1: ["Choose Your Desktop Friend", "Select a companion style to bring to your desktop screen.", "Select Companion Style"]
2: ["Your Pet is Ready for Work & Play!", "Use the shortcut key to toggle pet visibility anytime or right-click to open quick actions.", "Drag pet anywhere on screen | Right click for interaction menu | Press Alt+P to hide/show"]
3: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home...", "Your pet is unpacking its desktop toys. Feel free to test out desktop sound effects while you wait!"]
4: ["How Would You Like to Start?", "Pick a ready-to-play pet or design your own companion from scratch."]
5: ["Important: Sign in with the same account each time to ensure your adopted pet and settings remain saved."]
6: ["Use a well-lit photo with a clear background for best pet generation results.", "Bright lighting | Clear contrast | Single subject photo"]
7: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Click below to place your pet onto your desktop screen immediately.", "Summon Pet to Desktop"]
8: ["You can minimize this window. We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!"]
9: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Create an adorable companion that lives on your computer screen. Setup takes under 2 minutes!", "Begin Setup"]
